findings.title: Off-by-one boundary calculation in catalog pagination slice
findings.diagnosis: Off-by-one boundary calculation in catalog pagination slice: end boundary omitted the 5th item.
findings.pr_title: fix(BUG-PAGINATE-01): resolve Off-by-one boundary calculation in catalog pagination slice
findings.current_diff:
--- a/src/catalog/paginate.py
+++ b/src/catalog/paginate.py
@@ -3,3 +3,3 @@
     start = (page - 1) * page_size
-    end = start + (page_size - 1)
+    end = start + page_size
     return items[start:end]

findings.title: Fee calculator returns negative value on zero amount
findings.diagnosis: Fee calculator fails to handle zero/negative amounts, returning a negative fee value.
findings.pr_title: fix(BUG-ZERO-FEE-02): resolve Fee calculator returns negative value on zero amount
findings.current_diff:
--- a/src/payment/client.py
+++ b/src/payment/client.py
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 def calculate_fee(amount: float) -> float:
-    return -1.0 if amount <= 0.0 else amount * 0.02
+    return 0.0 if amount <= 0.0 else amount * 0.02

findings.title: Inverted boolean validation in auth token checker

findings.pr_title: fix(BUG-BOOL-FLAG-03): resolve Inverted boolean validation in auth token checker

--- a/src/auth/validator.py
+++ b/src/auth/validator.py
@@ -2,4 +2,4 @@
     if not token or len(token) < 8:
-        return True
-    return False
+        return False
+    return True

findings.title: CWE-89: SQL Injection in user tier query
findings.diagnosis: CWE-89: Dynamic string formatting in SQL query constructor introduces SQL injection vulnerability.
findings.pr_title: fix(SEC-SQLI-01): resolve CWE-89: SQL Injection in user tier query
findings.current_diff:
--- a/src/db/user_repo.py
+++ b/src/db/user_repo.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
-    cursor.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE tier = '{tier_name}'")
+    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE tier = ?", (tier_name,))
